objects.description: [GlassWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9010) has gathered data pertaining to VPN configurations.(Citation: Koi Glassworm New Tricks December 2025)(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)  [GlassWorm](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9010) has also targeted locally stored data on macOS located in `/Library/Application Support/Fortinet/FortiClient/conf/vpn.plist`.(Citation: Socket GlassWorm January 2026)
